heroHeadline: S&P 500 and Dow Enter Correction, Nasdaq Erases 2026 Gain as AI Selloff Hits Despite Hawkish Fed
heroSubtitle: On Nov 20 the S&P 500 and Dow closed about 10% below their highs and the Nasdaq turned negative for 2026 as investors sold AI stocks after the Anthropic IPO. Treasuries rallied (10-year 4.93%, 2-year 4.63%), yet futures still priced about a 92% chance of a 25bp December hike. October FOMC minutes showed near-consensus for further hikes, and Governor Waller said a half-point move may be needed.
footerNote: Data sourced from: ECB — 25bp hike to 2.25% (June 11, 2026); Bank of Japan — 25bp hike to 1.00% (June 16, 2026); Federal Reserve — FOMC statement + Summary of Economic Projections (June 17, 2026); Al Jazeera / Yahoo Finance — US-Iran MOU signed, Brent crash (June 17-18, 2026); Goldman Sachs — 15% recession probability confirmed (June 22, 2026); BEA — May 2026 PCE (June 25, 2026); BLS — June 2026 Employment Situation (July 2, 2026) and CPI (July 14, 2026); CNN / China NBS — Q2 2026 GDP (July 14, 2026); IMF — July 2026 World Economic Outlook Update (July 8, 2026); Dorsey & Whitney — Section 301 tariff timing analysis (July 7, 2026). Critical path: Section 122 cliff July 24 (8 days) → next FOMC July 28-29 (non-SEP) → China Politburo meeting (late July, stimulus watch).
